svg.title: Every skill and every auditor, and what makes it run
svg.desc: The praxis inventory. Left column, twelve skills and what triggers each: task-orchestrator, every implementation request, from a one-line prompt upward; prompt-architect, turns a vague ask into goal, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria; best-practices, picks the minimal fitting families: SOLID, DDD, REST, OWASP, testing; code-craft, naming, comments that explain why, no debug or dead code; quality-rubric, the vertical auditors plus the horizontal pass, then the report; docs-living, /docs, CHANGELOG, ADRs, kept true by every change; claudemd-living, the CLAUDE.md hierarchy, proposed as diffs and regression-verified; frontend-pipeline, any change to user-facing surface, sized full / feature / patch; repo-audit, a whole repository, sharded into a coverage ledger; git-delivery, Conventional Commit, branch, PR, merge policy, SemVer release; bootstrap, runs first and on its own in any repo praxis does not manage yet; capability-discovery, finds or builds a missing tool, MCP server, skill, or plugin. Right column, thirteen read-only subagents and the concern each one owns (ten of them are the vertical auditors that run on a change): adversarial-auditor, tries to break it: injection, auth, abuse, unsafe states; regression-sentinel, contracts, callers, and tests this change may have broken; duplication-scanner, reinvented wheels, and abstractions nothing needed; perf-scalability-analyst, complexity, hot paths, N+1, behaviour as load grows; edge-case-hunter, empty, null, huge, concurrent, malformed, unauthorized; doc-reference-finder, the authoritative docs, and the patterns already in the repo; debt-auditor, what the change costs later, and whether the shortcut was recorded; completeness-auditor, no stubs, no deferral, no scope quietly dropped; accessibility-auditor, WCAG: semantics, keyboard, focus, contrast, ARIA, motion; design-consistency-auditor, tokens, states, responsive coverage, story fidelity; finding-verifier, reverse audit: refute a finding before anyone acts on it; claudemd-verifier, guards a memory rewrite against losing a valid instruction; repo-cartographer, maps an unfamiliar codebase before anything is written.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

Skills are selected per prompt by the router. Auditors run read-only, in their own context, and report a verdict the gate can check.
